## Social, premium polish and hardened internals

This release turns the menu from a personal tool into a **social surface**. Players in proximity now discover each other's emotes, can join with one key, and the whole UI got a premium motion pass on top. Server-side rate limiting + anti-spoofing keep busy zones safe even at high player counts.

---

### New: Open Join — proximity emote broadcast

When you play a broadcast-eligible emote (dances, shared, ...), every player within radius sees a small **anonymous** pill at the bottom of the screen with the emote name and a hotkey. One press joins the same emote on their character. The initiator is **never named** to recipients — privacy by design.

![Open Join in action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_emote_menu/f131311/.github/release-assets/v1.3.0-open-join.png)

- Per-player opt-out via `/mbt_openjoin off` (persists across reconnects)
- Pill auto-dismisses within ~500ms when the initiator walks out of range or stops emoting — no more lingering invitations after the moment is gone
- Configurable position (`top-left`, `bottom-center`, ...), key, radius, and timeout
- Capped at the 30 closest recipients on crowded zones so a nightclub event doesn't fan-out into a network storm

### New: What's That Emote?

Passive discovery. Walk near someone who is emoting and a floating bubble shows the emote name above their head with a hotkey hint. One press copies it onto your own character.

![What's That Emote bubble](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_emote_menu/f131311/.github/release-assets/v1.3.0-whats-that.png)

- Off by default — opt-in via `MBT.Features.WhatsThat = true`
- Reads from replicated state bags only; never writes to remote players
- Tracking runs on the compositor (translate3d via CSS custom properties) so the bubble follows heads smoothly without per-frame layout reflow

### New: Nearby ribbon

When at least one player is within proximity, a dedicated ribbon surfaces above the category pills with your **most-played shared / duet emotes**, ranked by personal play count. One click starts a duet with the closest player via the Partner Finder.

The featured chip leads the row in filled accent; the overflow chip (`+N >`) jumps to the full Shared category. Counts animate, focus is keyboard-visible, the whole ribbon adapts to both default and cinematic chrome.

---

### New: drag-to-reorder favourites (actually working)

![Favourites reorder](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_emote_menu/f131311/.github/release-assets/v1.3.0-favorites-reorder.png)

The favourites tab has advertised drag-and-drop for a while, but CEF's HTML5 native drag implementation silently refused to start a drag on most builds. **Rebuilt on `react-dnd` + `TouchBackend`** (the same setup `ox_inventory` ships in production) so drag runs through pointer events instead of CEF's flaky HTML5 layer. Reorder persists to KVP exactly like before; QuickBindBar drops are wired through the same backend.

---

### Premium motion pass

Every social surface and the broader menu chrome got a polish round, all CSS-driven (no animation library bloat):

- **Open Join pill / What's That bubble**: slide + scale-up entry, accent ring pulse on arrival as a discovery cue, snappy 150ms scale-down + fade on exit
- **Nearby ribbon**: cinematic-aware gradient, focus-visible chips for controller / Tab navigation, header dot separator, `+N` chevron chip
- **Tabs**: directional slide on tab change via the View Transitions API (with graceful fallback)
- **Grid**: opacity + brightness morph on filter / category / search / sort change, virtual-scroll ref kept untouched
- **Numbers**: search counter, Nearby badge and Recent tab count animate up / down with a spring instead of snapping
- **Empty states**: floating illustration disc + animated arrow nudging toward the resolving action ("No emotes found" → "Search above", etc.)
- **Inline outcomes**: creating a custom list now pulses the new chip in the tab strip instead of firing a toast
- **`prefers-reduced-motion`**: respected throughout — all entry choreography collapses to a soft opacity fade

### Server-side hardening

- **Banned emotes blacklist** — server owners can blocklist specific emote names; both the catalog and the social broadcast layer filter them out
- **Per-source rate limiting** — every NetEvent the menu accepts is throttled per server ID (catalog request, job lookup, ecosystem status, social broadcast)
- **Client-side anti-spam** — cooldown between back-to-back emote plays (`MBT.AntiSpam.CooldownMs`, default 250ms)
- **Anti-spoofing** — server validates the initiator's replicated `mbtCurrentEmote` state bag against the announced emote before relaying. Clients that try to advertise an emote they aren't actually playing are dropped
- **Length caps** — emote names and labels are bounded server-side before fan-out, neutralising memory-DoS via huge strings
- **NUI listener hardening** — `event.origin` + message shape validation on both message handlers, drops noise from browser extensions or future third-party embeds

### Reliability

- **First-open race fix** — pressing the menu key before the server has finished shipping the catalog used to silently fail; you'd need to press a second time. The intent is now memorised (20s TTL) and the menu auto-opens as soon as the catalog lands
- **Origin ped guard** — Open Join broadcast skips just-connected / disconnecting players whose ped resolves to 0, preventing accidental fan-out to everyone near the world origin

---

### Install

Download `mbt_emote_menu.zip` below and drop it in your resources folder. Existing installs upgrade in place — favourites, recent list, wheel slots and custom lists are preserved.

If you previously bound the Emote Wheel hotkey, double-check **FiveM Settings → Key Bindings → MBT Emote Wheel (Hold)** after the update — FiveM caches keymappings per-resource and the binding may need re-confirming.

**Requires** [rpemotes-reborn](https://github.com/alberttheprince/rpemotes-reborn) latest. The "Place in world" feature on emote cards needs the build that exposes `StartNewPlacement` / `GetPlacementState` exports.
